<translate>
'''Kikono materials''' are the crafting materials of DMZ [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|armor]]. They all come from '''Kikono Shards''', mined from '''Namek Deepslate Kikono Ore''', the exclusive ore of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Materials ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Material</translate> !! <translate>How to get it</translate> !! <translate>Used for</translate>
|-
| <translate>Kikono Shard</translate> || <translate>Mine Namek Deepslate Kikono Ore (Fortune gives more). With Silk Touch you get the ore block, which you can smelt or blast into a shard.</translate> || <translate>Every other Kikono material. Repairs DMZ armor.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Kikono Block</translate> || <translate>9 Kikono Shards. It turns back into 9 shards.</translate> || <translate>Dr. Kikono's Station.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Kikono Stick</translate> || <translate>2 Kikono Shards, one above the other, give 2 sticks.</translate> || <translate>Gete tools (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Tech]]).</translate>
|-
| <translate>Kikono String</translate> || <translate>Kikono Shard + Armor Crafting Kit (shapeless) give 2 strings.</translate> || <translate>Armor pieces, Kikono Cloth.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Kikono Cloth</translate> || <translate>4 Kikono String + Armor Crafting Kit (shapeless).</translate> || <translate>Armor pieces.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Armor Crafting Kit</translate> || <translate>Red Wool + Shears (shapeless).</translate> || <translate>Crafting Kikono String, Kikono Cloth and the Pattern Station. It isn't consumed.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Other sources ==

The '''Armor Materials''' wish gives 32 Kikono Shards and 64 Iron Ingots from [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]], or 64 Kikono Shards and 128 Iron Ingots from [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]].
</translate>
